resources.string: Changes take effect after a reboot.
Disables SELinux enforcement until the next reboot. Makes the device meaningfully less secure while active — only for debugging, not something to leave on.
SELinux is now permissive. Resets to enforcing on reboot, or tap again.

Saves your Bootscreen choice, wallpaper color, and which Hexaphone Store apps are installed — not a real factory-reset-proof backup, since nothing survives a wipe without moving the file off-device yourself (USB/adb) first.
